review_summary: No independent or verified reviews exist for Rijschool Story on any third-party platform (klantenvertellen, Clickdrive, Trustoo, Trustpilot, Facebook). The only review text available is a curated block of short, anonymous testimonials on the school's own marketing website, praising instructor Timara for patience, a relaxed atmosphere, and passing on the first attempt.

red_flags: No presence on any independent or verified review platform (klantenvertellen, Clickdrive, Trustoo, Trustpilot, Facebook) found across 6 searches
Only review text is the self-published testimonial block on the school's own marketing website
Testimonials are short one-liners attributed to first names only, with no dates, instructor specifics, or verification
Very new, single-instructor school (instructor Timara Cirk started in 2023), so a thin independent review footprint is expected
Self-published testimonials cannot be cross-checked and may be cherry-picked or solicited
